div.head: I Ew 2.1
div.ab: Gyf he ðonne nan riht næfde ne on boclande ne on folclande, þæt se wære ðe rihtes wyrnde scyldig XXX scyl’ wið ðone cynnig, æt oðrum cyrre eac swa, æt ðriddan cyrre cyniges oferhyrnesse, þæt is CXX scyl’, buton he ær geswice.

Gif he ðonne nan riht næfde ne on boclande ne on folclande, þæt se wære þe rihtes wyrnde scyldig XXX scill’ wið þone cyning, ⁊ æt oðrum cyrre eac swa, æt ðriddan cyrre cyninges oferhyrnesse, ðæt is CXX scill., buton he ær geswice.

Si tunc rectum non habeat nec in boclánd nec in folclánd, sit ille qui rectum disfortiat reus XXX sol. erga regem; et altera uice item sic; ad terciam uicem ouerhyrnesse regis, hoc est CXX sol., si non cesset et satisfaciat antea.

Gif he ðonne nan riht næfde ne on boclande ne on folclande, þæt se wære þe rihtes wyrnde scyldig XXX scll' wið þone cyning, ⁊ æt oðrum cyrre eac swa, æt ðriddan cyrre cyninges oferhyrnesse, ðæt is CXX scll', buton he ær geswice.

If, however, he [the plaintiff] does not obtain his rights either in 'bookland' or 'folkland', he [the defendant] who withholds the rights shall forfeit a fine of 30 shillings to the king, and 30 shillings also on the second occasion, and on the third occasion the fine for insubordination to the king, that is 120 shillings, unless he has already desisted [from his wrong-doing].

Wenn [Kläg]er aber kein Recht erhalten kann, an Urkunden-Grundeigenthum oder an volks[rechtlichem] Grundeigen, dass der [Verklagte], der das Recht verweigert hat, 30 Schill. gegenüber dem Könige schuldig werde, und beim zweiten Male ebenso viel, beim dritten Male die [Summe für] Ungehorsam gegen den König, nämlich 120 Schill., es sei denn, er stehe früher ab [vom Rechtsweigern].

But if [the plaintiff] cannot obtain justice, concerning land held by charter or land held by folk-right, that the [accused] who has refused justice should become liable to the king for 30 shillings, and the second time as much, the third time the [sum for] disobedience to the king, namely 120 shillings, unless he desists [from refusing justice] beforehand.
